subject.title: [codex] acknowledge terminal Gmail OAuth watch failures

question: Should terminal Gmail OAuth failures be acknowledged after persisting a recovery marker, with users required to re-authenticate and run `gog gmail watch renew` or `watch start` to trigger catch-up?
rationale: The branch replaces retry-driven delivery behavior with acknowledgement plus an operator recovery workflow; the code and tests establish one implementation, but cannot determine whether that is the intended long-term delivery contract.

options.title: Approve persisted-marker recovery
options.body: Keep the proposed acknowledgement behavior after durable marker persistence, require re-authentication and renewal for catch-up, and document that operator step.

options.title: Retain retry-based delivery
options.body: Do not acknowledge terminal authorization failures until a different automatic recovery or operator-notification contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve persisted-marker recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed acknowledgement behavior after durable marker persistence, require re-authentication and renewal for catch-up, and document that operator step.

likelyOwner.reason: Project-level repository ownership is the only available routing signal for this Gmail-watch delivery-contract decision.
